questions.stem: What is the role of mRNA in protein synthesis?

options.text: It carries amino acids to the ribosome
It carries a copy of the DNA code from the nucleus to the ribosome
It joins amino acids together to form a protein
It breaks down proteins into amino acids

questions.explanation: Messenger RNA (mRNA) is made during transcription as a complementary copy of one strand of DNA. It carries the genetic code from the nucleus to the ribosomes, where translation occurs.
